verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents autonomous agents and Flows for building AI automations. Crews can be deployed to managed infrastructure, started via POST /kickoff, and tracked through GET /status/{kickoff_id}, so a run can execute asynchronously off the user's machine. A community user also built an email-handling crew. However, every documented run is a one-off kickoff: nothing in the evidence shows recurring schedules, cron-style or event triggers, or always-on background operation without an external caller. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or recurring triggers, explicit evidence of unattended always-on execution, independent corroboration of deployed background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Flows allow developers to combine and coordinate coding tasks and Crews efficiently, providing a robust framework for building sophisticated AI automations.
an `Agent` is an autonomous unit that can: * Perform specific tasks * Make decisions based on its role and goal
Deploy your crews to a managed infrastructure and monitor their execution in real-time.
Built a crew of AI agents with CrewAI to categorize emails, apply labels, draft responses, send Slack alerts, and delete low-priority mail.
